issues.reason: The oblique head must be "the preposition actually used — never a synonym head for a near-fit reading", and the instruction set's own event-attached `(Beside sk_sketch_1 sk_archive_1)` shows a non-containment spatial PP taking its surface head, so folding "around fires" into `Location` asserts an at/in-ness the text does not state and collapses two distinct spatial relations onto one head.

new_gaps: A NAMED calendrical occasion filling a Time slot ("on Lantern-night"): a named time is licensed to stay a bare symbol, but nothing states whether it also takes the name-internal kind atom the Kestrel River rule mandates (`(Member lantern_night night)`), or whether the deictic-time bar on ever emitting a `Member` atom for a time constant extends to a named one.
defect_summary: "around fires" takes the surface-preposition event oblique `(Around sk_tell_1 <fire-filler>)` in place of `(Location sk_tell_1 fire)`, in the group event and in the per-member distribution rule alike; the second `(Location sk_tell_1 sk_harbor_square_1)`, for the containment "in the harbor square", stands as it is.
notes: The dual emission (group event plus per-member rule at 1.0/0.9), the `harbor_square` genus with its noun modifier correctly unexposed, and the bare-symbol named time are all correct.
